subject: Damaged packaging - Cardiozan batch CZ-2208-A
body_text:
Good morning,

We received a delivery of Cardiozan 20 mg tablets this week, batch CZ-2208-A, expiry 09/2027. Three of the twelve cartons had crushed corners and the tamper-evident seals were broken on two of them.

No product has been dispensed to any patient from these cartons and we have quarantined the stock. Please advise on return arrangements.

Mark Delaney MRPharmS
Brookfield Pharmacy, Cork, Ireland
